hooks.command: d=$(jq -r '.cwd // empty'); cd "${d:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}" || exit 0; git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null; set -- $(git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main 2>/dev/null); [ "${1:-0}" != 0 ] || [ "${2:-0}" != 0 ] && echo "Local main is $1 commit(s) ahead of and $2 behind origin/main: bring it up to date before building on it."; true

d=$(jq -r '.cwd // empty'); cd "${d:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}" || exit 0; if git submodule status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^-'; then git submodule update --init --recursive -q && echo "Initialized the git submodules: the vendored skills in .claude/skills now resolve."; fi; true
